title: Hono App Plan
description: A structured plan of a Hono app's route ordering, middleware discipline, generics, CORS, cookies, and streaming settings, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/hono_patterns_audit.mjs.

middlewareAwaitsNext.description: True if every middleware that intends to continue awaits next() (short-circuits like auth failures excepted).

catchAllRegisteredLast.description: True if wildcard/catch-all routes are registered after all specific routes (or replaced by app.notFound).

routesValidated.description: True if every route that reads json/form/query/param/header/cookie input has a validator (e.g. zValidator) or explicit typed parsing.

onErrorSanitized.description: True if app.onError returns sanitized responses -- no error messages or stacks leaked to clients.

bindingsGenericDeclared.description: True if the root app declares the Bindings generic so c.env is typed.

variablesGenericDeclared.description: True if the root app declares the Variables generic so c.set/c.get are typed.

corsCredentials.description: True if CORS is configured with credentials: true (cookies ride cross-origin).

corsOriginPolicy.description: How the CORS origin is decided: a typed allowlist function, a literal *, or blindly echoing whatever Origin arrives.

hasStreamingEndpoints.description: True if the app serves SSE/NDJSON/raw streaming responses.

streamChecksAborted.description: True if every long streaming loop checks stream.aborted so client disconnects end the work.

loginUsesRedirect.description: True if the login flow sets a session cookie and redirects (Set-Cookie on a 302).

sessionCookieSameSite.description: The SameSite attribute on the session cookie.
